title: Boats for the Boatless
blurb: Boats for the Boatless Inc. rents well-maintained, fully equipped boats with a knowledgeable and friendly captain. Trips include fuel, insurance, and safety equipment. Guests can bring their own decorations, food, and drinks onboard.
extraNote: Cleaning fee of $300 if boat is left messy or damaged · Full refund if trip cancelled due to inclement weather · Full refund if cancelled at least 15 days before trip · Change fee of $100 if date changed within 7 days of trip · No changes within 24 hours of trip · No refund for no-shows · 333 Lakeshore Blvd East, Toronto, Ontario M5A 1B6
